latestVersion.changelog:
HD Video Editor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-powered HD video editor supporting MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB.
- Enables quick AI editing and export of 1080p MP4 files, optimized for content creators and YouTubers.
- Automatic session setup and free credits for new users (via API token).
- Supports core workflows: upload, edit, preview, export, credits check, and timeline state review.
- Provides clear error handling and usage guidance for smooth onboarding.
